retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle, wide-perspective group portrait featuring high-contrast sepia tones and architectural vaulted backgrounds.
triggerTerms: low angle group portrait leather jackets
excludeWhen: modern digital clean look is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned group photograph of four men in urban attire, shot from a low angle against a backdrop of grand, vaulted stone architecture. The lighting is dramatic, emphasizing the textures of leather and the depth of the architectural arches.
coreVisualRelationships: Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and scale
Repetition of arched architectural forms echoing the group's arrangement
High-contrast lighting defining the folds and sheen of leather garments
Monochromatic sepia palette unifying the subjects with the environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the midground, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figures' dark leather jackets provide a heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the vaulted ceiling down to the heads of the subjects, then moves left to right across their expressions.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is occupied by the intricate patterns of the stone vaulting.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and black shadows providing structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and light tan highlights in the stone and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone sepia washes throughout the mid-tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast (deep blacks vs bright highlights).

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of four men in 90s urban leather jackets standing under a large stone vaulted archway. Use a sepia-toned film aesthetic with high contrast and visible grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, sans-serif typography in a cream color, positioned either in the upper architectural space or centered at the bottom, using a slightly distressed texture to match the film grain.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/monochrome?
Are the subjects wearing leather-textured clothing?
Is the background a vaulted stone structure?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain film grain
Ensure the low-angle distortion is present to give subjects stature

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between highlights and shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows on faces
Verify the presence of stone vaulting patterns
Ensure leather texture has a visible sheen
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Sepia Portrait = (Low Angle + Wide Lens) * (Sepia Toning + High Contrast) + (Leather Textures + Stone Vaulting)
